info.name: Get sizing recommendations for virtual environments

params.name: activeSessionSizing
params.description:
Specifies which calculation method to use for sizing recommendations.

false: Calculates utilization averages across a continuous 24/7 period, regardless of whether a session is active. This includes nights and weekends when machines might be idle. If your machines have significantly different resource utilization depending on whether a session is active, then this method can under-estimate a machine's hardware requirements.

true: Only calculates utilization averages when an active user session is detected. This can provide a more realistic view of hardware requirements by excluding idle time.

params.name: _page
params.description: The page number returned. The first page is 1.

params.name: _limit
params.description: The number of items returned per page. Minimum is 1.

items.docs: Returns sizing recommendations to optimize resource allocation for machines based on historical information. Visit the Sizing Recommendations Report documentation for more details.

info.name: Get sizing recommendation for machine for Azure environment

params.name: license
params.description: Your license type for Microsoft Windows Virtual Machines. If you have Azure Hybrid Benefit, enter ‘Azure Hybrid Benefit’. If you purchase a new license for each machine, enter ‘OS (Windows)’.

params.name: azureRegion
params.description: The Azure region where you want to see representative costs. You must provide the name of the region as it appears in the report creation UI.

params.name: currency
params.description: The currency used for all cost information in the report.

params.name: msEaDiscountRatePct
params.description: The discount rate percentage due to a Microsoft Enterprise Agreement. If you don’t have a discount rate, enter `0`.

params.name: acceleratedNetworking
params.description: Select whether you require VMs with or without Accelerated Networking. Enter `any` if you have no preference.

params.name: memoryPreservingMaintenance
params.description: Select whether you require VMs with or without Memory Preserving Maintenance. Enter `any` if you have no preference.

params.name: hyperVGeneration
params.description: Select the required Hyper-V generation for VMs. Enter `any` if you have no preference.

params.name: cpuArchitectureType
params.description: Select the required CPU architecture for VMs. Enter `any` if you have no preference.

params.name: vCPUsPerCore
params.description: Select the required vCPUs per core for VMs. Enter `any` if you have no preference.

params.name: rdmaEnabled
params.description: Select whether you require RDMA-capable VMs. Enter `any` if you have no preference.

params.name: premiumIO
params.description: Select whether you require VMs with premium IO. Enter `any` if you have no preference.

params.name: encryptionAtHostSupport
params.description: Select whether you require VMs with encryption at host. Enter `any` if you have no preference.

params.name: diskTier
params.description: Select your required disk tier. Enter `any` if you have no preference.

params.name: redundancy
params.description: Select your required disk redundancy option. Enter `any` if you have no preference.

params.name: minimumDiskSize
params.description: Select your required minimum disk size in GB. Enter `any` if you have no preference.

params.name: costOption
params.description: Your Azure cost option. Select from pay as you go (`PAYG`), spot machines (`Spot`), reserved instance for one a one-year term (`RESERVED_ONE_YEAR`), or reserved instance for a three-year term (`RESERVED_THREE_YEAR).

params.name: _page
params.description: The page number returned. The first page is 1.

params.name: _limit
params.description: The number of items returned per page. Minimum is 1.

items.docs: Returns sizing recommendations to optimize resource allocation for machines based on historical information. Visit the Sizing Recommendations Report documentation for more details.

params.name: groupBy
params.description: Single machine dimension to group rows by.

params.name: metrics
params.description: One or more machine metrics to aggregate. Repeat the parameter for multiple values.

params.name: aggregations
params.description: Aggregation functions to apply to each metric. Repeat for multiple. Default: avg.

params.name: presetType
params.description: Metric compatibility scope. Restricts which metrics are valid. Default: Default (all metrics).

params.name: _sortBy
params.description: Response field to sort by (must equal a returned <metric>_<aggregation>, machine_count, or the groupBy field). Default: <first metric>_<first aggregation>.

params.name: _sortOrder
params.description: Sort order. Default: desc.

params.name: _timeFrom
params.description: Start date and time of the search period in the format: YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss.sssZ

params.name: _timeTo
params.description: End date and time of the search period in the format: YYYY-MM-DD'T'hh:mm:ss.sssZ

params.name: operatingSystem
params.description: Filter machines whose operating system contains this value (pre-aggregation filter).

params.name: hypervisorPlatform
params.description: Filter machines whose hypervisor platform contains this value (pre-aggregation filter).

params.name: azRegion
params.description: Filter machines whose Azure region contains this value (pre-aggregation filter).

params.name: azVmSize
params.description: Filter machines whose Azure VM size contains this value (pre-aggregation filter).

params.name: vmName
params.description: Filter machines whose VM name contains this value (pre-aggregation filter).

params.name: _page
params.description: The page number returned. The first page is 1.

params.name: _limit
params.description: Grouped rows per page. Default: 100, maximum: 10000.

items.docs: Returns aggregated machine metrics (avg/min/max/count) grouped by a single machine dimension such as folder, operating system, hypervisor platform, Azure region/VM size, or GPU architecture/model. Always returns machine_count (COUNT(DISTINCT computer_id)) plus one column per _ combination. Visit the Machine Statistics Report documentation for column descriptions and more details.
